北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天体感偏凉，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels a bit cool today, remember to keep warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 2℃，穿暖和点，小心感冒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 2℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，体感 6℃。出门戴口罩，注意防护。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is hazy, feels like 6℃. Wear a mask when going out for protection.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，体感 14℃，早晚温差大，别着凉。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 14℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，体感 16℃，很舒适，多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 16℃, very pleasant. Drink more water.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 4℃。早晚凉，记得添衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 4℃. It's cool morning and night, remember to add clothes.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 6℃，风和日丽，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 6℃, pleasant but keep warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃。气温适中，注意添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 9℃. The temperature is moderate, remember to add clothes.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 7℃。早晚温差大，注意增减衣物。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 7℃. Mind the temperature difference and adjust your clothing.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 3℃。天气干燥，多喝水，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 3℃. It's dry, drink more water and keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 8℃。出行注意安全，气温适中。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 8℃. Be careful when traveling, temperature is moderate.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨今天很冷，体感 -16℃，务必多穿，小心冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is very cold today, feels like -16℃. Dress warmly to avoid frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -11℃。风小，但很冷，注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cold, feels like -11℃. Light wind but very cold, remember to keep warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃，风力稍大，天气干燥，多补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 16℃ with a slightly stronger wind. It's dry, so hydrate well.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 8℃，风力较大，出门小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 8℃ with stronger winds. Be careful not to catch a cold when going out.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 -4℃，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like -4℃ with strong winds. Remember to protect from wind and keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -7℃，风有些凉，出门多加衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -7℃ with a cool wind. Wear more layers when going out.
